title: 25 Days of Shipping
description: Building different products in public. 25 days, multiple projects, daily releases. No excuses, just execution.

projects.name: Build Tracker
projects.description: A brutalist web app to track daily product releases

projects.name: Mind Galaxy
projects.description: AI-powered note-catching app to organize fleeting thoughts

projects.name: 4/3/2/1 Scanner
projects.description: Automated multi-timeframe trading scanner that detects high-probability entry signals across 200+ stocks

updates.title: Build Tracker - Foundation & Deploy
updates.description: Built the entire foundation for tracking 25 days of shipping. Created a brutalist-themed web app with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Designed multi-project data architecture to track 3 concurrent products. Deployed to both Vercel and GitHub Pages for public tracking.
highlights: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite setup
Brutalist design system with pixel borders and retro fonts
Multi-project tracker architecture (Build Tracker, DevSpeed CLI, QuickAPI)
Calendar grid with 25 days and status tracking
Deployed to Vercel + GitHub Pages
Project filtering and modal detail views
Responsive grid layout with pixel art aesthetic

updates.title: Calendar Dates & UI Polish
updates.description: Added real calendar date tracking to align the 25-day challenge with actual dates (Dec 21 → Jan 14). Completely redesigned the UI with day numbers as the hero element, making it bold and impactful. Improved visual hierarchy with status badges, inverted header design, and better stats display.
highlights: Real calendar date support with startDate tracking
Days auto-lock until their actual date arrives
Massive day numbers (6xl-7xl) as primary visual focus
Calendar dates small and subtle (12px, 50% opacity)
Status badges repositioned to top-left (DONE/WIP/LOCKED)
Inverted header: black background, white text
Big number stats badges with colored backgrounds
Project emoji badges in top-right of cards
Comprehensive project documentation in .claude/CLAUDE.md

updates.title: Mind Galaxy - Initial Setup
updates.description: Started a new AI-powered note-catching app to help capture and organize fleeting thoughts. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, integrated with Google Gemini API for intelligent thought organization.
highlights: React + TypeScript + Vite foundation
Google Gemini API integration for AI-powered organization
Project structure with components and services
Environment configuration for API keys
Initial repository setup and documentation

updates.title: Day 4: Multi-Project Updates
updates.description: Shipped updates for both Build Tracker and Mind Galaxy projects.

projectUpdates.title: View Switcher & UX Polish
projectUpdates.description: Added calendar/cards view toggle and project filter pills for easier navigation. Compact calendar design with monthly goal tracker.
highlights: Calendar/Cards view switcher
Always-visible project filter pills
Compact calendar design
Monthly goal tracker badge

projectUpdates.title: Visual Clustering & Node Design
projectUpdates.description: Enhanced thought visualization with improved cluster logic and minimal dot design for cleaner interface.
highlights: Tightened initial layout for better clustering
Minimal dot design for cleaner interface
Hover text for node details
Top 3 connection highlighting

updates.title: Day 5: Multi-Project Updates
updates.description: Refined both Build Tracker structure and Mind Galaxy clustering features.

projectUpdates.title: Project-Advent Improvements
projectUpdates.description: Fixed duplicate day numbering and enabled multiple projects per day. Enhanced calendar and cards view with better project filtering and monthly goal tracking.
highlights: Fixed duplicate day numbering issue
Enabled multiple projects per day support
Improved calendar view with multiple project dots
Enhanced cards view with tab switching for multi-project days

projectUpdates.title: Cluster Logic Refinements
projectUpdates.description: Refined cluster logic for better visual grouping and added cluster zoom effect for improved navigation.
highlights: Refined cluster logic for stronger visual grouping
Created cluster zoom effect for better navigation
Improved cluster boundary detection
Enhanced user interaction with clustered nodes

updates.title: Day 6: UI Polish & Performance
updates.description: Streamlined tracker interface and optimized Mind Galaxy clustering performance.

projectUpdates.title: Card View & Toolbar Redesign
projectUpdates.description: Fixed card ordering and unified toolbar design with integrated progress tracking.
highlights: Cards now sort by day number for correct display order
Unified toolbar with filters and progress bar in one row
Visual progress indicator showing completion percentage

projectUpdates.title: Advanced Clustering & Performance
projectUpdates.description: Implemented hierarchical clustering system with major performance optimizations.
highlights: 2-level cluster hierarchy with 3-layer zoom system
Performance boost: optimized physics and removed render bottlenecks
Better readability with orphan node handling and improved opacity

updates.title: AI Thinker Suggestions & Interaction Polish
updates.description: Enhanced node interaction responsiveness and added AI-powered thinker recommendations with intelligent caching.
highlights: Lowered zoom threshold to 0.7 for earlier, more responsive node clicks
AI-powered thinker suggestions: Gemini analyzes content to recommend top 3 relevant thinkers
Smart caching system for instant thinker display on re-opening nodes

updates.title: Day 8: Calendar Optimization & Semantic Positioning
updates.description: Final release of December cycle. Optimized Build Tracker calendar UX and introduced semantic positioning system for Mind Galaxy.

projectUpdates.title: Calendar View Polish & Navigation
projectUpdates.description: Improved calendar density and added automatic navigation when switching between release cycles.
highlights: Reduced calendar cell height to 24px for better vertical space usage
Auto-scroll to selected cycle's month when switching between December and January

projectUpdates.title: Semantic Positioning System
projectUpdates.description: Thoughts now arrange themselves by meaning instead of just AI-detected connections. Explored local AI embeddings but switched to OpenAI API due to bundling issues.
highlights: Built semantic positioning mode where similar ideas cluster together using AI embeddings
Tried local browser-based embeddings but hit technical issues with bundling
Switched to OpenAI API with smart rate limiting (processes 3 embeddings per minute)

updates.title: Embedding System Exploration
updates.description: Experimented with AI embeddings to arrange thoughts by meaning. Explored both local browser-based and cloud API options, dealing with technical challenges and API rate limits.
highlights: Built semantic positioning where thoughts cluster by meaning using AI embeddings
Tried local embeddings but hit bundling issues, switched to OpenAI API
Added smart rate limiting to handle API call restrictions

updates.title: Performance Fix & Clustering Foundation
updates.description: Fixed critical freezing bug and laid groundwork for automatic thought clustering. App now runs smoothly but clustering logic still needs implementation.
highlights: Fixed freezing bug caused by reading saved data 100 times on load
Set up embedding mode foundation for automatic clustering
Performance improved, but clustering positioning logic not yet active

updates.title: Embedding & Clustering Optimization
updates.description: Streamlined the embedding system with improved caching for 1500+ node vectors and 2D cluster visualization.
highlights: Optimized node vectorization cache and loading logic for faster embedding processing
Known Issue: Frontend freezes when clustering 100+ nodes to 2D - clustering algorithm needs optimization

updates.title: Critical Bug Fixes
updates.description: Fixed major bugs blocking visualization. Nodes position correctly, UI freeze eliminated, and storage errors resolved.
highlights: Fixed positioning: nodes now spread semantically instead of clustering at (0,0)
Eliminated freeze: reduced load from 30+ seconds to 2-5 seconds (or <1s cached)
Resolved storage quota errors preventing saves

updates.title: 4/3/2/1 Trading Scanner
updates.description: Built production-ready scanner that analyzes 200+ stocks across multiple timeframes (1D/4H/3H/2H/1H) with momentum confirmation (30M/5M). Achieved 100% accuracy matching TradingView signals.
highlights: Resolved data alignment issues - 100% accuracy vs TradingView
Multi-timeframe resonance analysis (1D, 4H, 3H, 2H, 1H)
Momentum confirmation system (30M, 5M)
Scans 200+ tickers in under 2 hours
CSV export with priority-ranked signals
Interactive launcher with customizable ticker lists

updates.title: Physics-Based Clustering
updates.description: Replaced the slow UMAP algorithm with a smooth, animated physics system. Thoughts now move toward similar ideas while keeping space between each other, creating natural clusters in real-time.
highlights: Built physics engine where similar thoughts attract and all thoughts repel for spacing
Smooth 60 FPS animation as nodes settle into meaningful clusters
Interactive node dragging while physics runs
Cosine similarity between embeddings controls attraction strength
